# aspnet-layered-service-scaffold

Install this skill into a project's `.agents/skills/` folder:

```sh
npx @pavel-agarkov/skills add --skill aspnet-layered-service-scaffold
```

Install it together with every skill that shares one of its tags:

```sh
npx @pavel-agarkov/skills add --tag dotnet
npx @pavel-agarkov/skills add --tag backend
npx @pavel-agarkov/skills add --tag scaffold
npx @pavel-agarkov/skills add --tag dotnet,backend
```

Remove it again with `npx @pavel-agarkov/skills remove --skill aspnet-layered-service-scaffold`. See the package README for all commands.
